issues_detected.description: Sensitive-element declarations are attributed to the Healthsheet, while accompanying caveats describe removal of highly sensitive information. The exact retained sensitive variables in version 3.1.0 remain unresolved; the caveats prevent treating this as a proven contradiction.
issues_detected.recommendation: Reconcile the sensitive-element declarations against the version 3.1.0 dictionaries and identify which categories were retained, generalized, or removed.

semantic_insights: The record explicitly distinguishes the project-level DOI from the version 3.1.0 DOI and explains source-specific release caveats.
Registered feature access and controlled raw-audio access are consistently distinguished, including agreement and review requirements.
The historical participant totals reconcile: 306 initial participants plus 136 and 391 additional participants equals 833, and version 3.1.0 reports no new participants.
The separate pediatric dataset remains a related resource; its participant count and ethics statements were not substituted for root-dataset evidence.
Feature-specific counts, repeated sessions, privacy exclusions, and failed feature generation explain why participant counts and feature-row counts need not match.
Processing parameters, software repositories, clinical-label provenance, and limitations of machine-generated annotations provide substantial technical transparency.
The funding context is supported by the explicit NIH Common Fund and Bridge2AI statements in funders, rather than inferred from the filename or invocation identity.
